in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Sylvanus is derived from the word 'silva' which means 'forest'. It is a name given to the Roman god of the wilderness, woodlands, and forests. While not directly related to the name Wilden, it is a name that shares the same theme of the wild and untamed.

in_english.name: Wilden

data.cultural_impact: The name Wilden carries a historical connection to the Anglo-Saxon cultures and can convey a sense of strength, independence, and freedom. In the present day, Wilden could also represent a rebellious or unconventional spirit.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, Wilden can refer to an untamed and unwavering faith in God, where the individual's connection to their inner spiritual world is as free and uninhibited as the natural world itself. Alternatively, the name might denote a reverence for the natural world and God's presence in creation. Wilden could also be seen as a reminder of the wildness and mystery of God, who, despite being all-knowing, remains somewhat unpredictable and inscrutable.
